additions.name: inventory_valuation_policies
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_valuation_policies(org_id TEXT NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0),record TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(org_id,product_id,revision)) STRICT

additions.name: inventory_valuations
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_valuations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,reference TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('ready','reviewed','rejected')),record TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(org_id,reference)) STRICT

additions.name: inventory_valuation_positions
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_valuation_positions(org_id TEXT NOT NULL,unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(org_id,unit_id)) STRICT

additions.name: inventory_value_effects
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_value_effects(movement_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,unit_id TEXT NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

additions.name: inventory_value_splits
additions.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_value_splits(child_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,org_id TEXT NOT NULL,sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,record TEXT NOT NULL,hash TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
